answer: Stake-weighted identity is the defense: every agent locks collateral for one vote, so power follows the bond, not the count of names. A random auditor demands a signed uniqueness proof from a sampled few; failing it slashes the whole stake. A Sybil farmer who scatters fake wallets across a meadow of addresses gains no extra weight, yet pays a fresh deposit for each. A gale of bogus accounts still sums to one stake, and a single forged comet attestation forfeits everything. The attacker pays locked capital plus near-certain loss on detection.
